info.name: ONDC Scheduled Ride Flow (Workbench BAP)
info.description:
Replays the ONDC workbench buyer (TRV10 2.1.0, SCHEDULED_TRIP) against the local BPP, then the seeded driver accepts the scheduled booking, starts with the OTP from the RIDE_ASSIGNED on_update and ends the ride. Callbacks land on the mock server's /workbench-bap. Each run drops at a random point drop_min_km..drop_max_km from pickup, so every ride has its own fare.

Local prerequisites (driver app):
- dhall-configs/dev/dynamic-offer-driver-app.dhall: noSignatureSubscribers must contain "workbench.ondc.tech" — the collection signs search/select/init/confirm with a placeholder signature, so the BPP skips verification for this subscriber (registry lookup still happens).
- dev/local-testing-data/mock-registry.sql: registry rows (BAP + BG) for workbench.ondc.tech / key c11d8b66-… so both Authorization and X-Gateway-Authorization resolve.
- dev/local-testing-data/dynamic-offer-driver-app.sql: whitelists the workbench in white_list_org, enables transporter_config.enable_ondc_scheduled_ride_support (Quote-based select/init), seeds the fleet owner's mobile number + fleet_owner_information so the fleet driver can go online.
- Restart the driver app after changing the dhall or transporter_config (ConfigPilot caches it in memory for 1h).

// the credit must clear the go-online threshold (subscriptionConfig.fleetPrepaidSubscriptionThreshold, 100 in dev),
// so take the cheapest plan at or above prepaid_min_plan_amount (env, default 500)
